name: mise
description: Dev tool versions, environment variables and tasks per project

notes.text: mise now loads .env files from each folder and its parents, after you approve each one. You have a .env in your home folder, a parent of almost every folder: until you run 'mise trust $HOME\.env' (it then loads in every shell under your home) or move it, the shell warns that it isn't trusted and mise's own commands stop with an error.
